newsitem.title: USA: Fed's FOMC begins meeting, no rate change expected.
newsitem.headline: Fed's FOMC begins meeting, no rate change expected.

text.p: U.S. Federal Reserve policymakers began their meeting to map interest rate strategy on schedule at 9:00 a.m. EDT (1300 GMT) on Tuesday, a spokesman said.
The central bank's policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee is expected to announce its decision at about 2:15 p.m. EDT.
Analysts have said they expect no change in short-term interest rates.
